label: War Child Records
release_notes: Charity compilation for War Child, a follow-up to the 1995 HELP album. 23 tracks, about 86 minutes.
Recorded mostly in one week in November 2025 at Abbey Road Studios. James Ford is executive producer; Jonathan Glazer is creative director.
Contributors include Arctic Monkeys, Pulp, Wet Leg, Depeche Mode, Fontaines D.C., Big Thief, Olivia Rodrigo and Beck.
The gatefold vinyl comes with a bonus Oasis live 7" (Acquiesce, from Wembley, Sept. 28, 2025).
Six covers (tracks 5, 6, 8, 12, 14, 23). Everything else is new material. Metacritic score 82.

pull_quotes.text: generally more hushed and jazzier than its predecessor

draft_comment: Star-studded charity comp, mostly new songs plus six covers, cut in about a week at Abbey Road with James Ford producing. Arctic Monkeys open it.

tracks.notes: Cover of "Lilac Wine", written by James Shelton for the 1950 Broadway revue Dance Me a Song. Earlier versions by Eartha Kitt (1953), Nina Simone (1966) and Jeff Buckley (Grace, 1994). Produced by Beck.

tracks.title: Depeche Mode - Universal Soldier
tracks.notes: Cover of "Universal Soldier", written and first recorded by Buffy Sainte-Marie (1964).

tracks.notes: Cover of "Black Boys on Mopeds" by Sinead O'Connor (I Do Not Want What I Haven't Got, 1990). The band chose a cover over an original.
